figures.title: Dopamine series and extended cycling
figures.summary: Figure7A six dopamine concentrations; Figure7B10 mM dopamine extended cycling. Caption states1 M hydrogen peroxide, retained distinctly from Figure3 1 mM; three samples per concentration and standard-deviation bars. Within the Figure7A comparison, ECL intensity decreased as dopamine concentration increased from 1 µM to 10 mM. The zero-dopamine trace is a separate comparison; no absolute intensities are digitized. The authors interpret the declining ECL response as dopamine quenching of the CdS-QD ECL system. This source interpretation does not establish a measured molecular binding pose or independently verified mechanism.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
